description: How is a country's power capacity split by fuel, and how exposed is it to current coal, gas and oil price moves?. Aggregates the WRI Global Power Plant Database for one country (capacity mix, fossil vs low-carbon share, MW per million people, oldest/largest plants) and joins World Bank Pink Sheet fuel benchmarks and the country's energy CPI to give a capacity-weighted fuel price change. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /answer (country*, limit); /countries (limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: power-fuel-exposure
